## 中文

- [功能] 新增窗口置顶功能，可从标题栏快速切换并记住设置。
- [功能] 新增可选的匿名使用人数统计，显示同时在线、今日活跃和累计安装；首次启动会明确征求同意，也可随时关闭。
- [体验] 公告和更新提示迁移到原生浮层，查看提示时游戏仍会继续加载和运行。
- [体验] 侧栏、窗口大小和游戏画面现在会实时同步调整，并改善缩放与双击标题栏体验。
- [优化] 重构 DMM / FANZA 游戏加载流程，隐藏启动包装页和无关横幅，只在真实游戏内容就绪后显示。
- [性能] 优化游戏域名预连接、缓存读取和侧栏滚动期间的后台刷新。
- [外观] 完善深色模式顶栏、底栏、侧栏和加载占位的一致性。

## English

- [Feature] Added a persistent always-on-top control in the title bar.
- [Feature] Added optional anonymous usage counts for online, daily active, and total installations, with explicit first-launch consent and an option to disable participation at any time.
- [Experience] Moved notices and update prompts to a native overlay so the game can continue loading and running underneath.
- [Experience] Synchronized sidebar transitions, window resizing, and the live game viewport, with smoother zooming and title-bar double-click behavior.
- [Improvement] Reworked DMM / FANZA startup so wrapper pages and unrelated banners remain hidden until the playable game frame is ready.
- [Performance] Improved game-origin preconnection, cache accounting, and background refresh behavior while scrolling.
- [Appearance] Unified dark-mode chrome surfaces and corrected the loading placeholder geometry.
